info.title: TrendsFast — The Trends API for AI Agents
info.description: Prepared V3 contract. Runtime requires TRENDS_V3_ENABLED plus accepted migrations/roles and source rights. Global queries do not require Product DNA. The legacy v1 API is described separately at /v1/openapi.json. API and MCP share the same wallet. Source adapters do not establish current global coverage.

get.description: At most five permitted observations from one stored public projection. No login, filters, provider/model calls or credit debit. Rights and expiry are rechecked on every read; responses are no-store. Empty means no eligible public snapshot, not no trends on the internet.

200.description: Public snapshot or honest empty/stale state

503.description: Public snapshot unavailable; no source work was started

post.description: An explicit new saved-data query. Uses a stable request UUID and maximum credits; no new provider or model research. Empty evidence results settle at zero credits.

200.description: Saved evidence-backed result and immutable usage receipt. data.brief groups items by what they are good for (trending now, audience conversations, creative references, search demand, competitor activity, references), names coverage gaps and suggests next steps; every item carries guidance with its evidence class, suggested uses and cautions. A Customers or Trending read with a confirmed context may add data.communities: the brand's communities' rules, culture, play and all-time top posts with what they share, as last read. A Trending call (product niche) may add data.items[].topic_history: where the item's topic is in its life across the days and channels of the fixed panel (state EMERGING, RISING, PEAKING, DECLINING or EVERGREEN, since, first_seen, peak_day, channels, the 7-day velocity, as_of and the method), or null until the topic has a lifecycle state; it is free and changes no price. An Ask answer adds answer_status, cited findings, missing_inputs and next_steps.

post.description: An explicit new query. Uses a stable request UUID and maximum credits. Without input.product it reads saved observations only. With input.product it first collects that product's sources fresh, within the product's price, for the owner's confirmed context; Search also asks AI assistants the category's question. data.new_research says whether it collected. Empty evidence results settle at zero credits.

Error402.description: Insufficient credits or maximum quote not accepted

Error404.description: V3 disabled or result not found

Error409.description: Request conflict, changed context, unresolved request or paused account. Recover by the same request ID.
